decisions.point: Per-body roots versus one Y-sort node (LY-31 option B)
decisions.chosen: One y_sort_enabled translation-only BodyRoot per body in the projection set, under one y_sort_enabled World; option B kept only as a recorded spike comparison
decisions.reason: Probed: nested y_sort_enabled nodes form one merged sort scope, so per-body roots do not split PR-5's single scope; B moves every node on an offset change and spreads body offsets into every presenter.

decisions.chosen: Body-first: BodyRoot owns seven band groups (Floor, Marks, Faces, Mounted, PropsActors, Caps, Dust)
decisions.reason: Honors BDY-33 and TR-shipbody-032 (one root per body); band-first would make seven sub-roots per body and is recorded as the remedy if a cross-body equal-key flip is observed.

decisions.point: Reparent versus rebuild on weld and cut
decisions.chosen: Reparent each moved section's nodes (SceneMove.to) and shift positions by frame_shift_px; no tile rebuild; rebuild path is kept for first build, arrival, restore, ALL and discard, with a rebuild_signature equivalence test
decisions.reason: A moved section's geometry does not change; reparent costs microseconds in probes, shows no gap, and lets the bead appear in the first frame; this answers ADR-0009 OQ-I.

decisions.chosen: Per section, one layer per kind (floor, wall face, mounted, cap)
decisions.reason: Section offsets are on a 24 px grid (the MVP pair is 14.5 tiles), so a 48 px body-level cell grid cannot hold welded sections; rebuilds and discards stay local; atlas sets differ per section.

decisions.chosen: Exactly one TileSetAtlasSource per TileSet, one TileSet per (atlas_set, layer_kind), preloaded in BOOTING
decisions.reason: Probed: two sources alternating by row cost 440 draw calls unsorted versus 1 for one source.

decisions.chosen: Wall-face and wall-mounted layers use cell height WALL_FOOTPRINT_DEPTH, TileData origin 0 and a layer y_sort_origin of depth/2 (key = footprint south edge)
decisions.reason: Probed: key = cell_top + tile_h/2 + origins, texture size irrelevant; the GDD's 'origin 24' holds only under one cell convention.

decisions.chosen: On the TileMapLayer node (one value per layer), TileData origin 0
decisions.reason: Both properties add (probed); one data-driven value per layer is simpler to lint.

decisions.chosen: Class rank = order of sorted groups Faces < Mounted < PropsActors; inside PropsActors children kept in (class_rank, entity_id) via SortedLayer with duplicate refusal
decisions.reason: Probed: equal keys tie by tree order, so tree order must equal the contract order; creation order and x are not save-stable.

decisions.chosen: Accept BodyRoot order (body_id ascending) as a bounded, documented exception, recorded as an SP-YSORT-1 observation
decisions.reason: Only occurs at the docked seam; coincides with entity_id order for Layout pieces in the MVP; band-first is the local remedy.

decisions.chosen: EntityId.pack(ns, local) = (ns<<56)|local in src/shared; LAYOUT 1, BODY 2, INTERACTION 3, HORROR 4, SUIT 5, WEB 6, TRAIL 7; 8..127 reserved append-only; golden test
decisions.reason: Positive signed int64, plain integer compare; closes Layout OQ-33; presentation composite only, never persisted, ADR-0003's block-local rule unchanged.

decisions.chosen: DOOR_LEAF 1, PROP 2, MACHINE 3, BEAD 4, PLATE 5, SCAR 6 plus JAMB 7; BEAD, PLATE, SCAR rank 1; the rest rank 2
decisions.reason: TR-assembly-045 names jambs, ADR-0013's closed six does not; fits the 8-bit field; assumption flagged on ADR-0013.

decisions.chosen: DoorSort.sort_y(y0, open_extent_px) from Layout's door_passage on LEAF keys; no graph.state subscription
decisions.reason: area leaving zero changes the leaf rect which marks LEAF; avoids waking stage 0 on every Graph step and needs no edge reverse lookup; equals area>0 when area_max does not exceed the doorway width (OQ-E).

decisions.chosen: Layout projector builds SectionScenes in a hidden in-tree Staging holder; body.projector mounts and moves them; ADR-0009 registration order unchanged
decisions.reason: A body root may not exist when the layout projector runs first; atomic commit prevents half-built sections; in-tree staging keeps OBJECT_ORPHAN_NODE_COUNT flat (probed).

decisions.chosen: One set_cell or one sprite node = one unit; BUILD_TILES_PER_FRAME (LayoutTuning) units per present; frames = ceil(U / budget); socket-state sprites and moves are never chunked
decisions.reason: Keeps 'N tiles in M frames' true with sprites included; bead must show in the first frame.

decisions.chosen: Gdd_sync: tiles_max becomes the work-unit count U of the largest destination scene, computed from real build_section output
decisions.reason: Avoids a numerator and denominator in different units.

decisions.chosen: Scenes exist for the avatar's body, the loaded set and the arriving target; leaving the set frees the scene (no hidden retention)
decisions.reason: GDD budgets the arrival rebuild; retention is an open option if the spike shows the arrival over budget.

decisions.point: Foreign presenter access to the tree
decisions.chosen: BodyScenes.attach/detach/attach_presenter with bands Marks, Mounted, PropsActors, Dust; non-actor attachments name their section; the projector sets z and shifts nodes on weld and cut
decisions.reason: Uniform reparent-on-weld; structurally satisfies 'no trail uses z 0 or +20'.

decisions.chosen: SceneMove.to = reparent(new_parent, false); one-argument reparent banned by lint
decisions.reason: Probed: default keep_global_transform rewrites local position; the TR forbids global-transform-preserving reparent.

decisions.chosen: Placement.at(off_prev, off_curr, alpha) with offsets from BodyView world/world_prev relative to the current avatar body, written with Placement.put in stage PROJECT
decisions.reason: Formula handed over by ADR-0015; single integer assignment point; offsets within 2^23 exact in float32.

decisions.chosen: BodyRoot.visible from a pure InteriorDrawRule with injected inputs (avatar body, Web Map docked set)
decisions.reason: Mechanism only; the docked input is ADR-0026's; hidden holder behaviour probed.

decisions.chosen: Integer base-px union of [section_offset, +size_tiles*TILE_PX) over the avatar body's sections, grown north by WALL_FACE_PX + WALL_FOOTPRINT_DEPTH, published as CameraLimits in stage PROJECT; solver is the only clamp
decisions.reason: Stage 0 precedes CAMERA_SOLVE so same-frame consumption; the north overhang lets the camera reach the wall face and cap that project up-screen; Camera2D.limit_* untouched (OQ-C).

decisions.chosen: ZBand FLOOR 0, MARKS 1, YSORT 10, CAPS 20, DUST 30 in one file; per-row fallback specified (window 10..899, caps 900, dust 910) but not built; built only if it lowers both draw calls and CPU at the spike
decisions.reason: PR-5 and TR-pxl-009 go/no-go; Light2D range_z probed inclusive and default +-1024.

decisions.chosen: Proposed; SP-YSORT-1 required for acceptance on a release export (RM-DESKTOP and RM-DECK), remapped to confirm the shape and measure the 8 ms weld P99, draw calls with real art and the cross-body tie
decisions.reason: All probes are editor-binary margin evidence; release export, Deck and real atlases are UNVERIFIED.

decisions.chosen: TR-section-024 and TR-shipbody-032 graded partial because the traceability index splits their halves with ADR-0009/0013 and ADR-0010
decisions.reason: Matches what /architecture-review will grep.

cross_adr_assumptions.assumption: Provides AttachResult and DetachResult carrying frame_shift_px per moved section; section_offset and sections_of reads; template size_tiles on the frozen template; section_id below 2^20 and rect idx below 2^16; a closed kind_ordinal vocabulary extended with JAMB 7 (ADR-0013 section 13 lists six); door_passage_into(section_id, via_id, out) carrying open_extent_px for each section of a mated hatch; an area_max not exceeding the doorway width invariant; LEAF/<section_id> marked whenever a leaf rect changes; static_version bumped for sections whose socket state changed.

BodyView exposes world_x/_y, world_prev_x/_y, body_of_actor and actor_of_seat as hot getters; BODY_TRANSFER carries cause and frame_delta; actor_id stays below 2^56 (int64 counter); the canvas-offset formula is left to this ADR and offsets stay within 2^23 so float32 positions are exact; body.projector may subscribe to body.state.

section_rects_into(section_id, out: QueryBuffer) rows carry idx, flags (DOOR_LEAF, PROP, MACHINE, HULL) and the current extent in section-local px, so the Layout projector can build sprites from the rect table.
No read of graph.state is required by the projector (door sort uses Layout's door_passage); GraphView.section_dormant is used only for diagnostics.

The kernel LOADING pass completes (including binding rebuild) before the first RUNNING frame, so on_discontinuity(RESTORE) in stage 0 rebuilds from consistent views; the projector holds no restore_after position (presentation).

The Avatar Presenter calls BodyScenes.attach_presenter(actor_id, node) at spawn and writes the node's position with Placement.put in stage AVATAR (2) after the projector's reparent in stage 0; it never reparents itself.

web.view publishes projection_sections_into(out: PackedInt32Array) -> int (ascending section ids of the loaded set plus the arriving target while still dormant) and a docked-or-welded-to-avatar-body read for WM-19; DERELICT_LOADED and pod_settle events are deliverable to the PROJECTOR class.

Every Light2D sets range_z_min <= ZBand.FLOOR and range_z_max >= ZBand.DUST (fallback maximum 910); the occluder builder reads the rect table and does not depend on these nodes; Lighting's pooled nodes are not attached through BodyScenes unless it chooses to.

Interaction, Horror and Suit presenters attach their sprites through BodyScenes.attach with namespaces INTERACTION 3, HORROR 4 and SUIT 5, a persisted local id below 2^56, class rank 2 (items, deployables, empty suits) or 3 (horror rigs), and their section_id; Trail attaches through Marks, Mounted and Dust with namespace TRAIL 7 and the Graph subject key as local id.

open_questions: OQ-A: ProjectionSet source (ADR-0026 web.view.projection_sections_into including the arrival target while dormant); only BodyProjector changes if the shape differs.
OQ-B: docked-or-welded input for WM-19 (Body docked takes a shift only Layout can compute; a Web Map read is assumed).
OQ-C: JAMB as kind_ordinal 7 (ADR-0013 lists six) or fold jambs into PLATE.
OQ-D: wall tile cell width and side-wall 24 px footprint pitch (art bible 8.2/8.5 and asset spec); the sort key depends on cell height only.
OQ-E: area_max versus doorway width; open_extent_px > 0 equals area > 0 only if area_max does not exceed the doorway width, else the projector reads the Graph area.
OQ-F: retaining hidden departed scenes to remove the arrival build; not built.
OQ-G: cross-body equal-key ties follow body order; adopt band-first if SP-YSORT-1 shows a visible flip.

UNVERIFIED and gated by SP-YSORT-1: all probes (nested merge, tie by tree order, tile key formula, z order, reparent semantics) on a release export, RM-DESKTOP and RM-DECK, real atlases and 96 px faces; 8 ms weld P99; D_ysort draw calls; y-sorted TileMapLayer update cost on Deck; behaviour under a 4.7 patch release.

toolu_01Psptis5EDJ6yKpVVL3i5V8.summary: ADR-0034 (Proposed, 2026-10-29) fixes the PROJECTOR scene shape and Y-sort from windowed probes on the 4.7.2 editor binary. Nested y_sort_enabled nodes sort as one merged group, so one y_sort_enabled translation-only BodyRoot per body under one y_sort_enabled World keeps PR-5's single scope. Each body root has seven z-band groups: Floor 0, Marks 1, Faces/Mounted/PropsActors 10 (sorted, in class-rank order), Caps 20, Dust 30. Equal keys tie by tree order, so a SortedLayer keeps children in (class_rank, entity_id) order; a TileMapLayer cell key is cell_top + tile_h/2 + origins (probed), so wall layers use 24-row cells with a layer y_sort_origin of depth/2. Tile maps are per section, one atlas source each, because section offsets sit on a 24 px grid (the MVP socket pair gives 14.5 tiles) and two atlas sources in one layer cost 440 draw calls against 1. A weld or cut reparents each moved section's nodes with SceneMove (reparent(p,false)) and shifts them; no tile is rebuilt, and the Layout projector builds the socket sprites unchunked in the same stage-0 pass. Builds are chunked in work units (tiles plus sprites) into a hidden in-tree Staging holder and committed atomically. entity_id is a presentation composite packed in src/shared with namespace bytes LAYOUT 1, BODY 2, INTERACTION 3, HORROR 4, SUIT 5, WEB 6, TRAIL 7. CameraLimits is an integer rect (section union, grown north by WALL_FACE_PX + WALL_FOOTPRINT_DEPTH) published in stage PROJECT. The per-row z-band fallback is specified but not built. SP-YSORT-1 remains the acceptance gate for the release export, Deck, real atlases and the 8 ms weld figure; the probes remove option B's premise, so the spike confirms rather than chooses. Coverage 7 covered, 7 partial, 7 owned elsewhere.

Close OQ-C (limits sink named) and OQ-I (weld and cut do not build tiles; socket sprites unchunked; arrival build is chunked in work units) on the PROJECTOR side; record the declared-class list Node2D, TileMapLayer, Sprite2D, TileSet, TileSetAtlasSource, AtlasTexture for both projectors; keep registration order layout projector, body.projector, occluder builder (this ADR relies on it); make rebuild_signature mandatory for both projectors.

Add src/shared/entity_id.gd and src/shared/entity_ns.gd as L0 files (pure ints) and a golden test for the namespace table; adopt the proposed lint pack PJT-01..PJT-10 (tree-walk, lexical and boot tiers) for src/presentation/projector/; note the PJT prefix does not collide with PRJ-nn.

One sentence confirming the presentation sort-key composite entity_id (EntityId.pack, namespace byte plus publisher id) does not conflict with the block-local entity-id rule and is never a block id or persisted.

decisions.point: Per-body roots versus one Y-sort node (LY-31 option B)
decisions.chosen: One y_sort_enabled translation-only BodyRoot per body in the projection set, under one y_sort_enabled World; option B kept only as a recorded spike comparison
decisions.reason: Probed: nested y_sort_enabled nodes form one merged sort scope, so per-body roots do not split PR-5's single scope; B moves every node on an offset change and spreads body offsets into every presenter.

decisions.chosen: Body-first: BodyRoot owns seven band groups (Floor, Marks, Faces, Mounted, PropsActors, Caps, Dust)
decisions.reason: Honors BDY-33 and TR-shipbody-032 (one root per body); band-first would make seven sub-roots per body and is recorded as the remedy if a cross-body equal-key flip is observed.

decisions.point: Reparent versus rebuild on weld and cut
decisions.chosen: Reparent each moved section's nodes (SceneMove.to) and shift positions by frame_shift_px; no tile rebuild; rebuild path is kept for first build, arrival, restore, ALL and discard, with a rebuild_signature equivalence test
decisions.reason: A moved section's geometry does not change; reparent costs microseconds in probes, shows no gap, and lets the bead appear in the first frame; this answers ADR-0009 OQ-I.

decisions.chosen: Per section, one layer per kind (floor, wall face, mounted, cap)
decisions.reason: Section offsets are on a 24 px grid (the MVP pair is 14.5 tiles), so a 48 px body-level cell grid cannot hold welded sections; rebuilds and discards stay local; atlas sets differ per section.

decisions.chosen: Exactly one TileSetAtlasSource per TileSet, one TileSet per (atlas_set, layer_kind), preloaded in BOOTING
decisions.reason: Probed: two sources alternating by row cost 440 draw calls unsorted versus 1 for one source.

decisions.chosen: Wall-face and wall-mounted layers use cell height WALL_FOOTPRINT_DEPTH, TileData origin 0 and a layer y_sort_origin of depth/2 (key = footprint south edge)
decisions.reason: Probed: key = cell_top + tile_h/2 + origins, texture size irrelevant; the GDD's 'origin 24' holds only under one cell convention.

decisions.chosen: On the TileMapLayer node (one value per layer), TileData origin 0
decisions.reason: Both properties add (probed); one data-driven value per layer is simpler to lint.

decisions.chosen: Class rank = order of sorted groups Faces < Mounted < PropsActors; inside PropsActors children kept in (class_rank, entity_id) via SortedLayer with duplicate refusal
decisions.reason: Probed: equal keys tie by tree order, so tree order must equal the contract order; creation order and x are not save-stable.

decisions.chosen: Accept BodyRoot order (body_id ascending) as a bounded, documented exception, recorded as an SP-YSORT-1 observation
decisions.reason: Only occurs at the docked seam; coincides with entity_id order for Layout pieces in the MVP; band-first is the local remedy.

decisions.chosen: EntityId.pack(ns, local) = (ns<<56)|local in src/shared; LAYOUT 1, BODY 2, INTERACTION 3, HORROR 4, SUIT 5, WEB 6, TRAIL 7; 8..127 reserved append-only; golden test
decisions.reason: Positive signed int64, plain integer compare; closes Layout OQ-33; presentation composite only, never persisted, ADR-0003's block-local rule unchanged.

decisions.chosen: DOOR_LEAF 1, PROP 2, MACHINE 3, BEAD 4, PLATE 5, SCAR 6 plus JAMB 7; BEAD, PLATE, SCAR rank 1; the rest rank 2
decisions.reason: TR-assembly-045 names jambs, ADR-0013's closed six does not; fits the 8-bit field; assumption flagged on ADR-0013.

decisions.chosen: DoorSort.sort_y(y0, open_extent_px) from Layout's door_passage on LEAF keys; no graph.state subscription
decisions.reason: area leaving zero changes the leaf rect which marks LEAF; avoids waking stage 0 on every Graph step and needs no edge reverse lookup; equals area>0 when area_max does not exceed the doorway width (OQ-E).

decisions.chosen: Layout projector builds SectionScenes in a hidden in-tree Staging holder; body.projector mounts and moves them; ADR-0009 registration order unchanged
decisions.reason: A body root may not exist when the layout projector runs first; atomic commit prevents half-built sections; in-tree staging keeps OBJECT_ORPHAN_NODE_COUNT flat (probed).

decisions.chosen: One set_cell or one sprite node = one unit; BUILD_TILES_PER_FRAME (LayoutTuning) units per present; frames = ceil(U / budget); socket-state sprites and moves are never chunked
decisions.reason: Keeps 'N tiles in M frames' true with sprites included; bead must show in the first frame.

decisions.chosen: Gdd_sync: tiles_max becomes the work-unit count U of the largest destination scene, computed from real build_section output
decisions.reason: Avoids a numerator and denominator in different units.

decisions.chosen: Scenes exist for the avatar's body, the loaded set and the arriving target; leaving the set frees the scene (no hidden retention)
decisions.reason: GDD budgets the arrival rebuild; retention is an open option if the spike shows the arrival over budget.

decisions.point: Foreign presenter access to the tree
decisions.chosen: BodyScenes.attach/detach/attach_presenter with bands Marks, Mounted, PropsActors, Dust; non-actor attachments name their section; the projector sets z and shifts nodes on weld and cut
decisions.reason: Uniform reparent-on-weld; structurally satisfies 'no trail uses z 0 or +20'.

decisions.chosen: SceneMove.to = reparent(new_parent, false); one-argument reparent banned by lint
decisions.reason: Probed: default keep_global_transform rewrites local position; the TR forbids global-transform-preserving reparent.

decisions.chosen: Placement.at(off_prev, off_curr, alpha) with offsets from BodyView world/world_prev relative to the current avatar body, written with Placement.put in stage PROJECT
decisions.reason: Formula handed over by ADR-0015; single integer assignment point; offsets within 2^23 exact in float32.

decisions.chosen: BodyRoot.visible from a pure InteriorDrawRule with injected inputs (avatar body, Web Map docked set)
decisions.reason: Mechanism only; the docked input is ADR-0026's; hidden holder behaviour probed.

decisions.chosen: Integer base-px union of [section_offset, +size_tiles*TILE_PX) over the avatar body's sections, grown north by WALL_FACE_PX + WALL_FOOTPRINT_DEPTH, published as CameraLimits in stage PROJECT; solver is the only clamp
decisions.reason: Stage 0 precedes CAMERA_SOLVE so same-frame consumption; the north overhang lets the camera reach the wall face and cap that project up-screen; Camera2D.limit_* untouched (OQ-C).

decisions.chosen: ZBand FLOOR 0, MARKS 1, YSORT 10, CAPS 20, DUST 30 in one file; per-row fallback specified (window 10..899, caps 900, dust 910) but not built; built only if it lowers both draw calls and CPU at the spike
decisions.reason: PR-5 and TR-pxl-009 go/no-go; Light2D range_z probed inclusive and default +-1024.

decisions.chosen: Proposed; SP-YSORT-1 required for acceptance on a release export (RM-DESKTOP and RM-DECK), remapped to confirm the shape and measure the 8 ms weld P99, draw calls with real art and the cross-body tie
decisions.reason: All probes are editor-binary margin evidence; release export, Deck and real atlases are UNVERIFIED.

decisions.chosen: TR-section-024 and TR-shipbody-032 graded partial because the traceability index splits their halves with ADR-0009/0013 and ADR-0010
decisions.reason: Matches what /architecture-review will grep.

cross_adr_assumptions.assumption: Provides AttachResult and DetachResult carrying frame_shift_px per moved section; section_offset and sections_of reads; template size_tiles on the frozen template; section_id below 2^20 and rect idx below 2^16; a closed kind_ordinal vocabulary extended with JAMB 7 (ADR-0013 section 13 lists six); door_passage_into(section_id, via_id, out) carrying open_extent_px for each section of a mated hatch; an area_max not exceeding the doorway width invariant; LEAF/<section_id> marked whenever a leaf rect changes; static_version bumped for sections whose socket state changed.

BodyView exposes world_x/_y, world_prev_x/_y, body_of_actor and actor_of_seat as hot getters; BODY_TRANSFER carries cause and frame_delta; actor_id stays below 2^56 (int64 counter); the canvas-offset formula is left to this ADR and offsets stay within 2^23 so float32 positions are exact; body.projector may subscribe to body.state.

section_rects_into(section_id, out: QueryBuffer) rows carry idx, flags (DOOR_LEAF, PROP, MACHINE, HULL) and the current extent in section-local px, so the Layout projector can build sprites from the rect table.
No read of graph.state is required by the projector (door sort uses Layout's door_passage); GraphView.section_dormant is used only for diagnostics.

The kernel LOADING pass completes (including binding rebuild) before the first RUNNING frame, so on_discontinuity(RESTORE) in stage 0 rebuilds from consistent views; the projector holds no restore_after position (presentation).

The Avatar Presenter calls BodyScenes.attach_presenter(actor_id, node) at spawn and writes the node's position with Placement.put in stage AVATAR (2) after the projector's reparent in stage 0; it never reparents itself.

web.view publishes projection_sections_into(out: PackedInt32Array) -> int (ascending section ids of the loaded set plus the arriving target while still dormant) and a docked-or-welded-to-avatar-body read for WM-19; DERELICT_LOADED and pod_settle events are deliverable to the PROJECTOR class.

Every Light2D sets range_z_min <= ZBand.FLOOR and range_z_max >= ZBand.DUST (fallback maximum 910); the occluder builder reads the rect table and does not depend on these nodes; Lighting's pooled nodes are not attached through BodyScenes unless it chooses to.

Interaction, Horror and Suit presenters attach their sprites through BodyScenes.attach with namespaces INTERACTION 3, HORROR 4 and SUIT 5, a persisted local id below 2^56, class rank 2 (items, deployables, empty suits) or 3 (horror rigs), and their section_id; Trail attaches through Marks, Mounted and Dust with namespace TRAIL 7 and the Graph subject key as local id.

open_questions: OQ-A: ProjectionSet source (ADR-0026 web.view.projection_sections_into including the arrival target while dormant); only BodyProjector changes if the shape differs.
OQ-B: docked-or-welded input for WM-19 (Body docked takes a shift only Layout can compute; a Web Map read is assumed).
OQ-C: JAMB as kind_ordinal 7 (ADR-0013 lists six) or fold jambs into PLATE.
OQ-D: wall tile cell width and side-wall 24 px footprint pitch (art bible 8.2/8.5 and asset spec); the sort key depends on cell height only.
OQ-E: area_max versus doorway width; open_extent_px > 0 equals area > 0 only if area_max does not exceed the doorway width, else the projector reads the Graph area.
OQ-F: retaining hidden departed scenes to remove the arrival build; not built.
OQ-G: cross-body equal-key ties follow body order; adopt band-first if SP-YSORT-1 shows a visible flip.

UNVERIFIED and gated by SP-YSORT-1: all probes (nested merge, tie by tree order, tile key formula, z order, reparent semantics) on a release export, RM-DESKTOP and RM-DECK, real atlases and 96 px faces; 8 ms weld P99; D_ysort draw calls; y-sorted TileMapLayer update cost on Deck; behaviour under a 4.7 patch release.

data.summary: ADR-0034 (Proposed, 2026-10-29) fixes the PROJECTOR scene shape and Y-sort from windowed probes on the 4.7.2 editor binary. Nested y_sort_enabled nodes sort as one merged group, so one y_sort_enabled translation-only BodyRoot per body under one y_sort_enabled World keeps PR-5's single scope. Each body root has seven z-band groups: Floor 0, Marks 1, Faces/Mounted/PropsActors 10 (sorted, in class-rank order), Caps 20, Dust 30. Equal keys tie by tree order, so a SortedLayer keeps children in (class_rank, entity_id) order; a TileMapLayer cell key is cell_top + tile_h/2 + origins (probed), so wall layers use 24-row cells with a layer y_sort_origin of depth/2. Tile maps are per section, one atlas source each, because section offsets sit on a 24 px grid (the MVP socket pair gives 14.5 tiles) and two atlas sources in one layer cost 440 draw calls against 1. A weld or cut reparents each moved section's nodes with SceneMove (reparent(p,false)) and shifts them; no tile is rebuilt, and the Layout projector builds the socket sprites unchunked in the same stage-0 pass. Builds are chunked in work units (tiles plus sprites) into a hidden in-tree Staging holder and committed atomically. entity_id is a presentation composite packed in src/shared with namespace bytes LAYOUT 1, BODY 2, INTERACTION 3, HORROR 4, SUIT 5, WEB 6, TRAIL 7. CameraLimits is an integer rect (section union, grown north by WALL_FACE_PX + WALL_FOOTPRINT_DEPTH) published in stage PROJECT. The per-row z-band fallback is specified but not built. SP-YSORT-1 remains the acceptance gate for the release export, Deck, real atlases and the 8 ms weld figure; the probes remove option B's premise, so the spike confirms rather than chooses. Coverage 7 covered, 7 partial, 7 owned elsewhere.

gdd_sync.new: The effective sort key of a wall-face tile equals its footprint south edge; no node in the Floor, Marks, Caps or Dust band has y_sort_enabled or is a descendant of a sorted group (by band, not ancestry)

gdd_sync.old: PR-5 z-band table: ONE Y-sorted Node2D
gdd_sync.new: One merged Y-sort scope: nested y_sort_enabled nodes sort as one group (probed); each body root is y_sort_enabled; band values are ZBand names (FLOOR 0, MARKS 1, YSORT 10, CAPS 20, DUST 30); camera limits (C8) add the north overhang WALL_FACE_PX + WALL_FOOTPRINT_DEPTH

gdd_sync.old: BDY-33 (d)/(f) and AC-BDY-92b: each body root owns exactly one child layer node with y_sort_enabled = true; Layout's section nodes are siblings of that layer; reparent on BODY_TRANSFER
gdd_sync.new: The body root is itself y_sort_enabled and owns seven band groups; the actor/props layer is PropsActors, preceded by Faces and Mounted; the Layout projector builds section scenes in Staging and body.projector mounts them; moves use SceneMove.to (reparent(parent, false)), which keeps local position; foreign nodes attach through BodyScenes.attach

gdd_sync.new: Shape decided in ADR-0034 (per-body roots, per-section TileMapLayers with one atlas source, reparent and shift on weld); SP-YSORT-1 confirms rather than chooses; LAYOUT_ID_NS = 1 with packing in src/shared/entity_id.gd; JAMB added as kind_ordinal 7; OQ-33 closed

gdd_sync.new: WM-19 realised as BodyRoot.visible driven by a Web Map read of the docked set; D.13 numerator becomes the projector work-unit count U (tiles plus sprites) of the largest destination scene, computed by a test from build_section output

gdd_sync.new: LAYOUT_ID_NS = 1; add EntityNs table (BODY 2, INTERACTION 3, HORROR 4, SUIT 5, WEB 6, TRAIL 7); ARRIVE_SETTLE_TICKS formula numerator is the work-unit count U

gdd_sync.new: Names its source: assets/data/presentation/atlas_map.json (template_id to MAINTAINED or WORN), boot lints ATLAS_MAP_TEMPLATE_UNKNOWN and ATLAS_MAP_MISSING; no Layout field carries wear

foundation_asks.ask: Add `limits: CameraLimits` (read-only) to SolverInput and name CameraLimits as the C8 sink written by body.projector in stage PROJECT; have PipelineRoot read ProjectorReadiness.is_ready() for the TRANSIT_HOLD latch; confirm D_ysort row ownership by ADR-0034 and that z band names (ZBand) are owned by src/presentation/projector/z_band.gd; world viewport content is the single ProjectorRoot/World tree.

Add a `presentation` data domain with manifest and `assets/data/presentation/atlas_map.json` (template_id to atlas_set MAINTAINED or WORN, integer-only closed schema, no ledger) with boot lints ATLAS_MAP_TEMPLATE_UNKNOWN and ATLAS_MAP_MISSING; confirm BUILD_TILES_PER_FRAME is read from the frozen LayoutTuning table by presentation.

Close OQ-C (limits sink named) and OQ-I (weld and cut do not build tiles; socket sprites unchunked; arrival build is chunked in work units) on the PROJECTOR side; record the declared-class list Node2D, TileMapLayer, Sprite2D, TileSet, TileSetAtlasSource, AtlasTexture for both projectors; keep registration order layout projector, body.projector, occluder builder (this ADR relies on it); make rebuild_signature mandatory for both projectors.

Add src/shared/entity_id.gd and src/shared/entity_ns.gd as L0 files (pure ints) and a golden test for the namespace table; adopt the proposed lint pack PJT-01..PJT-10 (tree-walk, lexical and boot tiers) for src/presentation/projector/; note the PJT prefix does not collide with PRJ-nn.

One sentence confirming the presentation sort-key composite entity_id (EntityId.pack, namespace byte plus publisher id) does not conflict with the block-local entity-id rule and is never a block id or persisted.

decisions.point: Per-body roots versus one Y-sort node (LY-31 option B)
decisions.chosen: One y_sort_enabled translation-only BodyRoot per body in the projection set, under one y_sort_enabled World; option B kept only as a recorded spike comparison
decisions.reason: Probed: nested y_sort_enabled nodes form one merged sort scope, so per-body roots do not split PR-5's single scope; B moves every node on an offset change and spreads body offsets into every presenter.

decisions.chosen: Body-first: BodyRoot owns seven band groups (Floor, Marks, Faces, Mounted, PropsActors, Caps, Dust)
decisions.reason: Honors BDY-33 and TR-shipbody-032 (one root per body); band-first would make seven sub-roots per body and is recorded as the remedy if a cross-body equal-key flip is observed.

decisions.point: Reparent versus rebuild on weld and cut
decisions.chosen: Reparent each moved section's nodes (SceneMove.to) and shift positions by frame_shift_px; no tile rebuild; rebuild path is kept for first build, arrival, restore, ALL and discard, with a rebuild_signature equivalence test
decisions.reason: A moved section's geometry does not change; reparent costs microseconds in probes, shows no gap, and lets the bead appear in the first frame; this answers ADR-0009 OQ-I.

decisions.chosen: Per section, one layer per kind (floor, wall face, mounted, cap)
decisions.reason: Section offsets are on a 24 px grid (the MVP pair is 14.5 tiles), so a 48 px body-level cell grid cannot hold welded sections; rebuilds and discards stay local; atlas sets differ per section.

decisions.chosen: Exactly one TileSetAtlasSource per TileSet, one TileSet per (atlas_set, layer_kind), preloaded in BOOTING
decisions.reason: Probed: two sources alternating by row cost 440 draw calls unsorted versus 1 for one source.

decisions.chosen: Wall-face and wall-mounted layers use cell height WALL_FOOTPRINT_DEPTH, TileData origin 0 and a layer y_sort_origin of depth/2 (key = footprint south edge)
decisions.reason: Probed: key = cell_top + tile_h/2 + origins, texture size irrelevant; the GDD's 'origin 24' holds only under one cell convention.

decisions.chosen: On the TileMapLayer node (one value per layer), TileData origin 0
decisions.reason: Both properties add (probed); one data-driven value per layer is simpler to lint.

decisions.chosen: Class rank = order of sorted groups Faces < Mounted < PropsActors; inside PropsActors children kept in (class_rank, entity_id) via SortedLayer with duplicate refusal
decisions.reason: Probed: equal keys tie by tree order, so tree order must equal the contract order; creation order and x are not save-stable.

decisions.chosen: Accept BodyRoot order (body_id ascending) as a bounded, documented exception, recorded as an SP-YSORT-1 observation
decisions.reason: Only occurs at the docked seam; coincides with entity_id order for Layout pieces in the MVP; band-first is the local remedy.

decisions.chosen: EntityId.pack(ns, local) = (ns<<56)|local in src/shared; LAYOUT 1, BODY 2, INTERACTION 3, HORROR 4, SUIT 5, WEB 6, TRAIL 7; 8..127 reserved append-only; golden test
decisions.reason: Positive signed int64, plain integer compare; closes Layout OQ-33; presentation composite only, never persisted, ADR-0003's block-local rule unchanged.

decisions.chosen: DOOR_LEAF 1, PROP 2, MACHINE 3, BEAD 4, PLATE 5, SCAR 6 plus JAMB 7; BEAD, PLATE, SCAR rank 1; the rest rank 2
decisions.reason: TR-assembly-045 names jambs, ADR-0013's closed six does not; fits the 8-bit field; assumption flagged on ADR-0013.

decisions.chosen: DoorSort.sort_y(y0, open_extent_px) from Layout's door_passage on LEAF keys; no graph.state subscription
decisions.reason: area leaving zero changes the leaf rect which marks LEAF; avoids waking stage 0 on every Graph step and needs no edge reverse lookup; equals area>0 when area_max does not exceed the doorway width (OQ-E).

decisions.chosen: Layout projector builds SectionScenes in a hidden in-tree Staging holder; body.projector mounts and moves them; ADR-0009 registration order unchanged
decisions.reason: A body root may not exist when the layout projector runs first; atomic commit prevents half-built sections; in-tree staging keeps OBJECT_ORPHAN_NODE_COUNT flat (probed).

decisions.chosen: One set_cell or one sprite node = one unit; BUILD_TILES_PER_FRAME (LayoutTuning) units per present; frames = ceil(U / budget); socket-state sprites and moves are never chunked
decisions.reason: Keeps 'N tiles in M frames' true with sprites included; bead must show in the first frame.

decisions.chosen: Gdd_sync: tiles_max becomes the work-unit count U of the largest destination scene, computed from real build_section output
decisions.reason: Avoids a numerator and denominator in different units.

decisions.chosen: Scenes exist for the avatar's body, the loaded set and the arriving target; leaving the set frees the scene (no hidden retention)
decisions.reason: GDD budgets the arrival rebuild; retention is an open option if the spike shows the arrival over budget.

decisions.point: Foreign presenter access to the tree
decisions.chosen: BodyScenes.attach/detach/attach_presenter with bands Marks, Mounted, PropsActors, Dust; non-actor attachments name their section; the projector sets z and shifts nodes on weld and cut
decisions.reason: Uniform reparent-on-weld; structurally satisfies 'no trail uses z 0 or +20'.

decisions.chosen: SceneMove.to = reparent(new_parent, false); one-argument reparent banned by lint
decisions.reason: Probed: default keep_global_transform rewrites local position; the TR forbids global-transform-preserving reparent.

decisions.chosen: Placement.at(off_prev, off_curr, alpha) with offsets from BodyView world/world_prev relative to the current avatar body, written with Placement.put in stage PROJECT
decisions.reason: Formula handed over by ADR-0015; single integer assignment point; offsets within 2^23 exact in float32.

decisions.chosen: BodyRoot.visible from a pure InteriorDrawRule with injected inputs (avatar body, Web Map docked set)
decisions.reason: Mechanism only; the docked input is ADR-0026's; hidden holder behaviour probed.

decisions.chosen: Integer base-px union of [section_offset, +size_tiles*TILE_PX) over the avatar body's sections, grown north by WALL_FACE_PX + WALL_FOOTPRINT_DEPTH, published as CameraLimits in stage PROJECT; solver is the only clamp
decisions.reason: Stage 0 precedes CAMERA_SOLVE so same-frame consumption; the north overhang lets the camera reach the wall face and cap that project up-screen; Camera2D.limit_* untouched (OQ-C).

decisions.chosen: ZBand FLOOR 0, MARKS 1, YSORT 10, CAPS 20, DUST 30 in one file; per-row fallback specified (window 10..899, caps 900, dust 910) but not built; built only if it lowers both draw calls and CPU at the spike
decisions.reason: PR-5 and TR-pxl-009 go/no-go; Light2D range_z probed inclusive and default +-1024.

decisions.chosen: Proposed; SP-YSORT-1 required for acceptance on a release export (RM-DESKTOP and RM-DECK), remapped to confirm the shape and measure the 8 ms weld P99, draw calls with real art and the cross-body tie
decisions.reason: All probes are editor-binary margin evidence; release export, Deck and real atlases are UNVERIFIED.

decisions.chosen: TR-section-024 and TR-shipbody-032 graded partial because the traceability index splits their halves with ADR-0009/0013 and ADR-0010
decisions.reason: Matches what /architecture-review will grep.

cross_adr_assumptions.assumption: Provides AttachResult and DetachResult carrying frame_shift_px per moved section; section_offset and sections_of reads; template size_tiles on the frozen template; section_id below 2^20 and rect idx below 2^16; a closed kind_ordinal vocabulary extended with JAMB 7 (ADR-0013 section 13 lists six); door_passage_into(section_id, via_id, out) carrying open_extent_px for each section of a mated hatch; an area_max not exceeding the doorway width invariant; LEAF/<section_id> marked whenever a leaf rect changes; static_version bumped for sections whose socket state changed.

BodyView exposes world_x/_y, world_prev_x/_y, body_of_actor and actor_of_seat as hot getters; BODY_TRANSFER carries cause and frame_delta; actor_id stays below 2^56 (int64 counter); the canvas-offset formula is left to this ADR and offsets stay within 2^23 so float32 positions are exact; body.projector may subscribe to body.state.

section_rects_into(section_id, out: QueryBuffer) rows carry idx, flags (DOOR_LEAF, PROP, MACHINE, HULL) and the current extent in section-local px, so the Layout projector can build sprites from the rect table.
No read of graph.state is required by the projector (door sort uses Layout's door_passage); GraphView.section_dormant is used only for diagnostics.

The kernel LOADING pass completes (including binding rebuild) before the first RUNNING frame, so on_discontinuity(RESTORE) in stage 0 rebuilds from consistent views; the projector holds no restore_after position (presentation).

The Avatar Presenter calls BodyScenes.attach_presenter(actor_id, node) at spawn and writes the node's position with Placement.put in stage AVATAR (2) after the projector's reparent in stage 0; it never reparents itself.

web.view publishes projection_sections_into(out: PackedInt32Array) -> int (ascending section ids of the loaded set plus the arriving target while still dormant) and a docked-or-welded-to-avatar-body read for WM-19; DERELICT_LOADED and pod_settle events are deliverable to the PROJECTOR class.

Every Light2D sets range_z_min <= ZBand.FLOOR and range_z_max >= ZBand.DUST (fallback maximum 910); the occluder builder reads the rect table and does not depend on these nodes; Lighting's pooled nodes are not attached through BodyScenes unless it chooses to.

Interaction, Horror and Suit presenters attach their sprites through BodyScenes.attach with namespaces INTERACTION 3, HORROR 4 and SUIT 5, a persisted local id below 2^56, class rank 2 (items, deployables, empty suits) or 3 (horror rigs), and their section_id; Trail attaches through Marks, Mounted and Dust with namespace TRAIL 7 and the Graph subject key as local id.

open_questions: OQ-A: ProjectionSet source (ADR-0026 web.view.projection_sections_into including the arrival target while dormant); only BodyProjector changes if the shape differs.
OQ-B: docked-or-welded input for WM-19 (Body docked takes a shift only Layout can compute; a Web Map read is assumed).
OQ-C: JAMB as kind_ordinal 7 (ADR-0013 lists six) or fold jambs into PLATE.
OQ-D: wall tile cell width and side-wall 24 px footprint pitch (art bible 8.2/8.5 and asset spec); the sort key depends on cell height only.
OQ-E: area_max versus doorway width; open_extent_px > 0 equals area > 0 only if area_max does not exceed the doorway width, else the projector reads the Graph area.
OQ-F: retaining hidden departed scenes to remove the arrival build; not built.
OQ-G: cross-body equal-key ties follow body order; adopt band-first if SP-YSORT-1 shows a visible flip.

UNVERIFIED and gated by SP-YSORT-1: all probes (nested merge, tie by tree order, tile key formula, z order, reparent semantics) on a release export, RM-DESKTOP and RM-DECK, real atlases and 96 px faces; 8 ms weld P99; D_ysort draw calls; y-sorted TileMapLayer update cost on Deck; behaviour under a 4.7 patch release.
